registryBasis: Official Fuqing government material identifies the Fuqing Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and its Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center, including unified natural-resource/real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, and results application. The bureau-hosted Fuqing Smart City Planning Network publishes the public geospatial-platform notice.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official notice says the public geospatial platform provides publicly usable survey results, including vector basemap coverage for 400 square kilometres and imagery coverage for 1,899 square kilometres; the later official article describes municipal One Map platforms and public planning information.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local custodian and public-platform claims were verified, but the platform's current JavaScript/configuration, parcel layer, anonymous response schema, CRS, and stable native parcel identity were not verified. Coverage figures are not treated as cadastral parcel completeness.

technicalBlocker: Bounded TLS GET to https://fqghj.net/index.aspx timed out after 12 seconds; bounded HTTP GET to http://www.fqghj.net:9002/Portal/index.html timed out after 12 seconds; bounded GET to https://fujian.tianditu.gov.cn/map also did not complete within the run window. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS-verification weakening was used. Because the viewer did not yield current JavaScript/configuration or an API response, no safe ID-plus-geometry request could be made.
remainingUncertainty: The official platform may expose public planning or cadastral layers through a responsive browser/API route, and the local registration system may expose cadastral maps under authorization. The exact WUP point was not shifted and no exact-point absence inference is made.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may qualify an anonymous first-party parcel endpoint only after independently verifying current configuration, layer semantics, schema, CRS, stable native identity, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
